todos.title: Fix 'TypeError: isDate is not a function' on remote -> local transfer
todos.description: ssh2@1.13.0 uses util.isDate, removed in Node 23+ (newer VS Code). Bumped ssh2 to ^1.17.0, which uses util.types.isDate. Verified with an in-process SFTP repro on Node 24.

todos.title: Fix invalid package.json and compile errors on develop
todos.description: Trailing comma in package.json 'bugs' (upstream 9a6c5d7) broke npm. createCommand.ts used *_TO_ALL_PROFILES constants without importing them. paths.ts passed strings into a Uri-typed getFileSystemPath (would crash on macOS); restored published 1.16.3 toRemotePath.

todos.title: Add GitHub workflow to build .vsix and create releases
todos.description: .github/workflows/release.yml: builds a platform-neutral .vsix (npm ci --ignore-scripts --omit=optional) on push/PR as an artifact; on v* tags checks the tag matches package.json version and publishes a GitHub release with the .vsix.

todos.title: Rebrand fork: publisher tungpun, bump to 1.16.4, update README
todos.description: publisher/author -> tungpun (Natizyskunk kept in contributors), displayName 'SFTP (tungpun fork)', repo/bugs/homepage -> tungpun/vscode-sftp, status bar tooltip 'SFTP@tungpun'. README: fork header, ID comparison table, VSIX install, build and release steps. Extension ID is now tungpun.sftp.

todos.title: Fix broken jest setup
todos.description: 3 of 4 suites fail with 'Invalid return value' from test/preprocessor.js (preprocessor incompatible with installed jest). Pre-existing, unrelated to the ssh2 fix.
